topics.name: 1 · Ancient Medicine
topics.notes: Mesopotamian medicine mixed spiritual healing (prayers, incantations, amulets, divination) with practical treatment (herbal remedies, wound care).

questions.q: Which of these belongs to Mesopotamian SPIRITUAL medicine?
questions.explain: Spiritual medicine used prayers, incantations, spells, amulets, astrology, divination and omens. The other options are practical medicine.

questions.q: Which of these belongs to Mesopotamian PRACTICAL medicine?
questions.explain: Practical medicine covered herbal remedies and wound care.

questions.q: The Ebers Papyrus is best known as a text on what?
questions.explain: The Ebers Papyrus is one of the oldest medical texts, full of remedies and treatments.

questions.q: Who is traditionally called the Father of Medicine?
questions.explain: Hippocrates of Kos is traditionally called the Father of Medicine.

questions.q: Which set lists the three doshas of Ayurveda?
questions.explain: Ayurveda describes vata, pitta and kapha as the three doshas.

questions.q: Who is associated with classical conditioning experiments using dogs?
questions.explain: Ivan Pavlov studied classical conditioning in dogs.
